_comment: Data-driven objectives. Objective types: stat (counter >= target; scope run|lifetime), money (balance), workers (role/any, optional post), depth_unlocked, facility_built, facility_level, equipment_level (depth, equipment), tool_tier, tech (id), techs (count), discovered (resource), discoveries (count), income (per minute), prestige (count), automation (stage index), quests (count). Rewards: money, rp, boost (id). 'hint' names the UI panel to highlight.

quests.title: Break Ground
quests.description: Tap the ore vein to swing your pick. Mine 10 units by hand.

quests.title: Up the Shaft
quests.description: Wind the lift to bring 10 units of ore to the surface.

quests.title: Payday
quests.description: Dispatch the truck and sell 10 units of goods at the railhead.

contracts._comment: Rotating delivery contracts: sell N units of an item currently in production within the time limit for a bonus of reward_mult x its sale value.
